title: Informix folds names to lower case; JSON keys built from the model kept its case
symptom: Every history check crashed: TypeError comparing None and str
cause: The audit trigger wrote JSON keys in the model's mixed case (SK_TimeID) while the schema read from Informix is lower case, so every key came back None
effect: A model with mixed-case names breaks text built from it on Informix unless it folds the names the way Informix does
fix: Write the keys in lower case; the check also sorts keys with a missing part instead of crashing
